summary: Payment voucher stuck in suspense after PO's GRN reference format changed — three-way match rejected for Northforge Labs
description: Issue summary: An AP payment voucher for vendor 'Northforge Labs' (INV-2026-1187) is stuck in the AP suspense queue because the automated three-way match failed after a recent PO amendment changed the GRN reference formatting. Impact: Scheduled payment (net-30) due 2026-03-15 is not being released; vendor has contacted Finance Ops. Environment: Production AP matching engine (ap-match-svc v3.4.1), payments pipeline in us-east. Affected PO: PO-78821. Affected invoices: INV-2026-1187. Steps to reproduce: 1) Create PO PO-78821 and ship; original GRN referenced as "GRN-000874" 2) PO amendment performed on 2026-03-09 changed GRN reference to "GRN#874" during manual update in Console 3) Invoice INV-2026-1187 posted referencing "GRN#874" 4) ap-match-svc attempted three-way match and rejected line due to strict regex expecting hyphenated GRN format Expected behavior: ap-match-svc should normalize common GRN formats (dash, hash, space) and match invoice to GRN. Actual behavior: Matching rule rejects GRN with '#' causing match score < threshold and routing voucher to suspense. Logs/evidence: ap-match-svc logs show 'GRN_FORMAT_MISMATCH' and match_score=0.45 for invoice INV-2026-1187 (threshold 0.8). Transaction id: txn-pay-20260312-88ef. Attachments: screenshot of invoice, excerpt of PO amendment audit trail. Temporary workaround applied: AP agent manually matched invoice to PO and released voucher for a single-payment run; however this bypassed normal controls and cannot be used at scale. Next steps: investigate matching rules and parsing normalization; propose quick fix to normalization layer and longer-term fix to make matching tolerant. Owner: Diego Alvarez (Finance Ops)
comments: 2026-03-12 09:14 - Maya Chen: Vendor escalated — Northforge called CS asking why payment not received. Created ticket and moved to P1. Attached invoice PDF and PO amendment audit log.

2026-03-12 10:02 - Diego Alvarez: Verified voucher in suspense queue. ap-match-svc returned match_score below threshold; flagged as GRN_FORMAT_MISMATCH. Manual match performed to release this single voucher as emergency workaround.

2026-03-12 14:45 - Priya Kapoor (Payments Eng): ap-match-svc uses strict regex in normalizer (expects 'GRN-\d+'). We saw a recent Console edit flow that allows '#' in free-text updates. Investigating whether the Console input sanitizer changed in last deploy.
2026-03-13 08:33 - Diego Alvarez: Reproduced on staging: invoice with 'GRN#874' fails match; invoice with 'GRN-874' passes. Adding a normalization rule in payments-config could be fast mitigation.

2026-03-14 11:20 - Priya Kapoor (Payments Eng): Raised hotfix PR to add '#' normalization and common separators (PR-19). Need approvals from security/release to ship to prod. Also recommending weakening regex to allow optional non-alphanumeric separators.

2026-03-14 15:05 - Diego Alvarez: Scheduled emergency deploy window with Eng for 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC to push normalization hotfix. Finance to hold manual release until hotfix is live for remaining vouchers.
2026-03-14 17:40 - Finance Director (Anika Rao): Approved emergency deploy. Also request post-deploy test run for all vouchers in suspense filtered by 'GRN_FORMAT_MISMATCH' and vendor Northforge.
resolution: In progress: hotfix PR created to add GRN normalization and relax matching regex. Emergency deploy scheduled 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC. Workaround: single voucher released manually; do not manually release other vouchers until hotfix deploy completes.
